status.quote: Token Factory: inference API for open models

retention.value: kept by default for Speculative Decoding; period not stated
retention.quote: Unless you enable Zero Data Retention, we keep your inputs and outputs to speed up inference using the Speculative Decoding technique described in Section 3.
retention.note: No number of days is given in the guide or the Terms of Service; the retained inputs and outputs are stored in Finland (EU).

zdr.quote: For maximum privacy and control, you can enable Zero Data Retention in your account settings.
zdr.note: Self-serve opt-out rather than a request to sales: it is off by default and the customer turns it on for the whole organization; the Terms of Service name the onboarding form or an email to support as the opt-out route.

zdr_how.value: Activate Zero Data Retention on the account profile page; it applies to the whole organization
zdr_how.quote: How to enable it: activate Zero Data Retention on your account profile page.
zdr_how.note: The guide says enabling it may reduce inference speed because Speculative Decoding is switched off.

training.quote: As part of providing the Service, the Company collects and processes both Input and Output data for the purpose of training smaller Models used exclusively for Speculative Decoding.
training.note: The Legal Quick Guide says the opposite in plain words (Your content is not used to train any models in either mode) and also says the Terms of Service prevail; opting out is done by enabling Zero Data Retention.

soc2.quote: We are a certified company holding ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications.
soc2.note: The report itself is available through the Trust Center, with certain reports shared under NDA.

attestations.quote: We are a certified company holding ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications.
attestations.note: The Nebius Trust Center also lists SOC 3, HIPAA, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, ISO 27032, ISO 27799 and ISO 42001 for Nebius as a whole, without naming Token Factory.

subprocessors.quote: This page identifies the sub-processors engaged by Nebius to process Customer Personal Data on behalf of Customers in connection with Nebius Token Factory under the applicable Data Processing Agreement.
subprocessors.note: The first seven provide cloud infrastructure for model processing, the last five monitoring, communications and support; other Nebius Group entities are listed for engineering and support. List effective September 23, 2026.

value: Global (no region commitment on public endpoints)
regions.quote: The processing location is decided dynamically, is not tied to any single data center, and can change at any time without prior notice.
regions.note: The sub-processor list gives infrastructure processing locations of the United States, France, Iceland, Finland, the United Kingdom, Israel and Canada.

funding.note: The Legal Quick Guide says the contracting entity's publicly listed parent company is Nebius Group N.V. (NASDAQ: NBIS).
